gaps: No country-level data for any display or accessibility setting except the Netherlands (Appt, apps). Country funnels must use the platform or worldwide rate and say so.
prefers-reduced-motion on iOS: Appt publishes no iOS reduce-motion figure (its raw data has none) and no other public source was found.

prefers-reduced-motion / prefers-contrast / forced-colors / prefers-reduced-transparency / inverted-colors in Chrome: no user-state use counter exists. Chromium records the user state only for dark mode (PreferredColorSchemeDark 3580, PreferredColorSchemeDarkSetting 3581, in StyleEngine::UpdateColorSchemeMetrics). The counters PrefersReducedMotionMediaFeature (4961), PrefersContrastMediaFeature (3869), ForcedColorsMediaFeature (3870), PrefersReducedTransparencyMediaFeature (4962), InvertedColorsMediaFeature (4965) and NavigatorDoNotTrack (2655) only record that a page queried the feature (e.g. 4961 = 58.5% of page loads on 2026-09-21), so they say nothing about how many users have the setting on.
color-gamut, dynamic-range, 12/24-hour overrides, first day of week: no public prevalence data (CLDR defaults only).
GPC and DNT outside Firefox desktop: no measured public data (Brave and DuckDuckGo send GPC by default; Safari dropped DNT).

ITU DataHub (datahub.itu.int, api.datahub.itu.int) returned HTTP 403 (CloudFront) to every scripted request on 2026-09-23. The one settings-related ITU series found, the ICT skill "changing privacy settings on your device, account or app" (SDG 4.4.1), was taken from the UN SDG Global Database instead (privacySettingsChanged, context only). No ITU series on browser display, accessibility, DNT/GPC or ad-blocking settings was found.
